DECLARE
 temp_bagid varchar2(6);-- char(2);
 temp_catalog_no varchar2(10);
 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 /*IF upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_bag_id) != 'M' THEN
 validate_bagid_scan_coexist(:ctrl_blk_1.s_bag_id, temp_bagid);
 IF not form_success THEN

 IF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND -- catalog number (scanninng with the container ID)
 substr( :s_catalog_number, 13, 2 ) = '&)' THEN -- lot number identifier
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,12), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else

 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,13);
 End If;
 
 ELSIF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND substr( :s_catalog_number, 12, 2 ) = '&)' then -- for catalog number without continer ID 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,11), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :catalog_number := temp_catalog_no;
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,12);
 End If;
 
 ELSE -- catalog scan only 
 
 If substr(:ctrl_blk_1.s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.s_catalog_number ), 0) in (12,13) then 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(:s_catalog_number, temp_catalog_no);
 If form_failure then
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= '';
 ---:s_bag_code_desc := '';
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 
 if length(temp_catalog_no)=10 then
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no;
 else
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; 
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('9812','-'||:s_catalog_number);
 check_package_failure; 
 End If; 
 END IF; 
END IF;

END;

procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_process_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is

v_sysdate date;

 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 SELECT decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_process_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_process_date,v_sysdate), -- Modified sydsate to v_sysdate; AV; IM:8464
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_process_date,v_sysdate)+(life_span / 24)), -- Modified sydsate to v_sysdate; AV; IM:8464
 life_span_ind
 INTO p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind

 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 AND product_code = substr(p_product_code ,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = temp_c_code_scheme;
 
 IF temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 THEN
 p_new_expdate := 
 to_date(to_char(p_new_expdate,'mmddyyyy')||'235959','mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 p_new_expdate := :pool_expiry_dats;
END;
